display_name: DURA 联合与扩散频率融合源训练
description: 冻结 DURA、联合粒子与残差扩散，学习逐频三专家混合，输出单条 IQ；不使用 F 或 TX 真值训练。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU2 FP32 TF32 off deterministic; frozen source experts and GPU spectral gate; CPU frozen classifier; CPU truth scorer

data.version: fixed source training cache epochs21/22/23; source diagnostic epoch19
data.representation: Paired source received/clean and frozen DURA output/physical variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 17632 legal L_s/U_s IDs exclude RX4/6/8 day3, parent fit 32768 and 672 source pilot

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 64 source ID GPU optimizer smoke and 112 source no-query frozen-reader smoke

permissions.claim_scope: F-free/TX-label-free paired source IQ training; F used only in separate source no-query preflight and frozen ground evaluation

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA and fixed source-only joint particle and residual diffusion, fresh spectral mixture initialized toward DURA
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Two source-only fixed 32768-ID parent fits use matching source roles and IDs; 17632 gate records exclude both parent fit and 672 pilot IDs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed expert checkpoints and matching source L_s/U_s contract; no F/TX/V/target in gate training; classifier only separate smoke and frozen evaluation
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch20, no target/source-score checkpoint selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU2: one this-task GPU worker, >=8192 MiB free and fewer than 3 total compute apps per GPU stage; preserve all other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only on source contract or role mismatch, nonfinite computation, wrong checkpoint, target leakage, output collision, failed no-query smoke, or unrecoverable technical failure; preserve artifacts and other owners.

metric_names: source normalized IQ and DURA guard loss

rows.method: Per-frequency softmax of DURA, fixed joint-particle and fixed residual-diffusion IQ spectra; fixed source-calibrated low-noise gate
rows.purpose: Train only on authorized source paired IQ; no F/TX/V/target input
rows.seed_notes: Mixture model 2026110823; fixed source selection 2026110611; order 2026110824; parent fixed seeds retained; evaluation 2026092701
rows.budget_ref: 17632 parent-held-out physical source IDs x 3 views x 20 epochs, batch128, frozen parents

notes: Train only on parent-held-out L_s/U_s paired IQ, no F, TX identity, V or target; fixed original source noise gate.
Three frequency-wise expert weights are computed from the current IQ only; model is not claimed to preserve identity.
Final epoch20 followed by all seven fixed Phase1 ground predictions and independent truth-last; historical test is exposed, not an independent blind or real-satellite test.
